select: SELECT h.id, h.room_no as roomNo, h.status, h.area, u.unit_no as unitNo, CAST(LEFT(h.room_no, LEN(h.room_no) - 2) AS INT) as floorNum FROM community_house h JOIN community_unit u ON h.unit_id = u.id JOIN community_building b ON u.building_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{buildingId} ORDER BY floorNum DESC, u.unit_no, h.room_no
